code=r'''
import numpy as np
y=np.load('y.npy'); folds=np.load('folds.npy')
lgb=np.load('pass_1/logits.npy'); bp=lgb.argmax(1)
marg=np.sort(lgb,1); marg=marg[:,-1]-marg[:,-2]; low=marg<np.percentile(marg,25)
def mf1(y,p):
    f=[]
    for c in range(4):
        tp=((p==c)&(y==c)).sum(); fp=((p==c)&(y!=c)).sum(); fn=((p!=c)&(y==c)).sum()
        f.append(2*tp/max(2*tp+fp+fn,1))
    return np.mean(f)
def ridge_pred(X,T,lam,folds=folds,w=None):
    out=np.zeros((len(X),T.shape[1]))
    for f in range(folds.max()+1):
        tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
        mu=X[tr].mean(0); sd=X[tr].std(0)+1e-6
        Z=(X[tr]-mu)/sd; Zte=(X[te]-mu)/sd; tm=T[tr].mean(0)
        B=np.linalg.solve(Z.T@Z+lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]),Z.T@(T[tr]-tm))
        out[te]=Zte@B+tm
    return out
def summ(name,lg_or_pred):
    p=lg_or_pred.argmax(1) if lg_or_pred.ndim==2 else lg_or_pred
    return f'{name}: acc {(p==y).mean():.3f} mf1 {mf1(y,p):.3f} agree {(p==bp).mean():.3f} low-agree {(p[low]==bp[low]).mean():.3f}'
def full_report(pd, k, lams=(30,100,300)):
    lge=np.load(f'{pd}/logits.npy')
    r2=1-((lge-lgb)**2).sum()/((lgb-lgb.mean(0))**2).sum()
    print(summ('orig head',lge)+f' logitR2 {r2:.3f}')
    X=np.load(f'{pd}/cls_hidden_L{k}.npy')
    for lam in lams:
        o=ridge_pred(X,lgb,lam); r2=1-((o-lgb)**2).sum()/((lgb-lgb.mean(0))**2).sum()
        print('  '+summ(f'refit lam{lam}',o)+f' R2 {r2:.3f}')
'''
open(WORK/'anal.py','w').write(code)
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK)); from anal import *
full_report('pass_4',5)
